function.name: game_scores_get
function.description: Retrieve scores and rankings based on player’s performance in a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

level.description: The level of the game for which you want to retrieve the scores.

player.description: The name of the player for whom you want to retrieve scores. Default ''

function.name: game_rewards_get
function.description: Retrieve information about different types of rewards that you can receive when playing a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

platform.description: The gaming platform e.g. Xbox, Playstation, PC

mission.description: The mission for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

trophy.description: The trophy level for which you want to know the rewards. Default to ''

function.name: game_missions_list
function.description: List all missions for a certain game. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.reasoning: The user wants to find rewards for different missions in Fortnite on PlayStation. We need to call game_rewards_get with game="Fortnite", platform="Playstation", mission maybe unspecified or we can list all missions. The user didn't specify a particular mission, so we might list all missions first. But the request: "尋找在Playstation平台上玩Fortnite時不同任務和獎益的獎勵。" Means "Find the rewards for different missions and benefits when playing Fortnite on PlayStation." So likely they want to list rewards for each mission. We can call game_missions_list to get missions, then for each mission call game_rewards_get. But we don't have to do multiple calls; we can just call game_rewards_get with mission unspecified to get all rewards? The function signature: mission optional default ''. So if we pass mission='', it might return all rewards? But unclear. Probably better to call game_missions_list to get missions, then call game_rewards_get for each mission. But we can also ask clarifying question: "Which specific missions?" But the user says "different missions" meaning all. So we should provide a list of missions and their rewards. Let's call game_missions_list first.
